int_name: N BROAD ST & W YORK ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane urban roadway with a marked crosswalk and traffic signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and crosswalks are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a pedestrian refuge island increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway and near the crosswalk could cause tripping or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground and middle ground

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with multiple travel lanes and a gas station on the corner. While crosswalks and traffic signals are present, the large crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area mid-street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder-style markings for better visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban intersection with significant crossing distances and faded pavement markings. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the environment is dominated by vehicle-centric design with minimal pedestrian protection or traffic calming.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The continental crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground crossing the side street

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The corner design allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side corner near the Dunkin' building

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a commercial intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a faded crosswalk. However, the environment is dominated by wide asphalt surfaces, multiple driveways, and utility poles that create a cluttered visual field for drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk across the side street is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the intersecting street

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii and Driveway Conflict
hazards.description: The large open area for the Dunkin' drive-thru and parking lot creates multiple conflict points where vehicles may turn across the pedestrian path at higher speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the corner

hazards.name: Visual Clutter
hazards.description: Numerous utility poles and overhead wires may distract drivers or partially obscure pedestrians waiting at the corner.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left and center sidewalk areas

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded parallel lines with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and tighten the turn radius for vehicles entering the side street.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the commercial entrance to slow turning vehicles and clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.
